summary.text: Bill Hall is a Republican state representative from District 3 who was appointed to the seat in 2024 and is seeking re-election in the New Mexico House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a New Mexico State University graduate who worked as an agent for the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

paragraphs.text: The San Juan County Commission appointed Bill Hall to the New Mexico House of Representatives on April 3, 2024, to replace T. Ryan Lane.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Judiciary Committee and the Labor, Veterans' and Military Affairs Committee.
